Q: Efficient Search Across Elasticsearch and Neo4j Without Pulling Large Result Sets A:

First Option: Sync Neo4j Attributes to Elasticsearch

json

// Elasticsearch document
{
  "eid": "123",
  "city": "Shiraz",
  "gender": "male"  // ← synced from Neo4j
}

  • Query ES with all filters: city=Shiraz AND gender=male

  • Use Neo4j only for graph traversal

  • Implement via CDC (Neo4j Streams/Kafka) or periodic sync jobs

  • When: Neo4j attributes are relatively static

Alternative: Two-Phase Query (Query Smaller Dataset First)

Option A - Neo4j First (if Neo4j filter is selective):

cypher

// 1. Get filtered eids from Neo4j
MATCH (p:Person {gender: 'male'})
WITH collect(p.eid) AS eids

// 2. Query ES only for those eids
CALL apoc.es.query('index', 'city:Shiraz AND eid:(' + eids + ')')

Option B - ES First with Limits:

cypher

// 1. Get paginated ES results (size=100)
CALL apoc.es.getRaw('index', '?q=city:Shiraz&size=100')
YIELD value
UNWIND value.hits.hits AS hit

// 2. Filter in Neo4j
MATCH (p:Person {eid: hit._source.eid, gender: 'male'})
RETURN p LIMIT 20

Quick Fixes:

  • Always use pagination (&size=100) to avoid large transfers

  • Apply most selective filter first (determine via cardinality)

  • Cache common filter combinations in app layer

Q: Vim: Set Color/Theme based off time of day A:

If you are on MacOS and want VIM to follow the dark/light mode setting on OS level this does the trick:

colorscheme solarized

" Auto Light-/Dark mode
function! AutoDarkMode(timer)
  let darkMode = system("defaults read -g AppleInterfaceStyle")
  if darkMode =~ 'Dark'
    set background=dark
  else
    set background=light
  endif
endfunction

function! AutoDarkModeSetup()
  let timer = timer_start(3000, 'AutoDarkMode', {'repeat': -1})
  call AutoDarkMode(timer) " Initial call to setup the theme
endfunction
call AutoDarkModeSetup()

This sets a ticket to read the setting from the OS every 3s and adjusts the background accordingly.

Q: Do I still need a mac to develop react-native applications for iOS? A:

You can run your build on your IOS, even if you have a windows, with the help of Expo
but if you want to create a user build you will need a mac device to use XCODE

Q: Galera Cluster: All Nodes Slowed Down After Update Query and Too Many Connections Error A:

It was not fully confirmed, but we observed that CTAS statements could cause crashes in earlier versions.
After upgrading to a newer version, the issue was resolved.
The following issues appear to be related.

The previous version was MariaDB 10.5.13, and this issue appears to have been resolved starting from MariaDB 10.5.16.
We upgraded to MariaDB 10.5.27, and the problem has not reoccurred since then.

* https://github.com/MariaDB/server/commit/61daac54d62491fac9b699bccd639494da38a72f
* https://jira.mariadb.org/browse/MDEV-27806?jql=project%20%3D%20MDEV%20AND%20component%20%3D%20Galera%20AND%20text%20~%20%22Unknown%20error%201950%22

Q: Angular 21 Signal Forms: TypeError: this.field(...) is not a function A:

I ran into the same issue:
ERROR TypeError: this.field(...) is not a function

In my case, the root cause was that the form field value was being set to undefined.

The fix is to make sure the value is never undefined.

For example:

this.value.set(undefined); // ❌ Don't do this – some components may emit undefined
this.value.set('value');   // ✅ Correct – use any value except undefined

Once I ensured the value was always defined, the error disappeared.

Hope this helps.

Q: Excel formats and copies text instead of just formatting A:

As was mentioned you have to use "Conditional Formatting".

  1. Check if you have formulas in the cells you want to format

  2. Select the cells you want to format (e.g: column F)

  3. Click on "Format > Conditional Formatting ..."

  4. In the "Manage Rules" Dialog click on the "+" sign in the lower left corner to create a new formatting rule

  5. In the "New Formatting Rule" dialog select "Style: Classic", "Use a formula to determine which cells to format", Formula "=$E1<>$F1" and "Format with: Customised Format > Font > Font style: Bold"

(If you want to format cells F2:F100, you have to change the formula to represent the first line of your cells: "=$E2<>$F2")

This should do the trick!
